All five verification steps and exact sl2, rank-one roots, rho, classification and Racah-Speiser suppliers checked. Shift t=a+b+1-2j vanishes exactly for j=(a+b+1)/2 within 0..b, equivalent to a<b and a+b odd. Negative shifts start at floor((a+b+1)/2)+1, excluding the wall in odd parity. Survivors are |a-b|..a+b in steps of two; arithmetic progression dimensions sum to (a+1)(b+1). Zero factors, a=b=0, a=b, b=a+1, and both parity cases checked.
